newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fujitsu 97/98 group net profit seen doubling - paper.
newsitem.headline: Fujitsu 97/98 group net profit seen doubling - paper.

text.p: Fujitsu Ltd is expected to post a group net profit of about 80 billion yen in the year to March 31, 1998, twice as large as its estimated group net profit for 1996/97, a Japanese business daily said on Thursday.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said Fujitsu was also likely to post a group net profit of 40 billion yen in 1996/97, against an actual group net profit of 63.11 billion yen in 1995/96.

The paper said higher profits in the company's computer-related division, helped by other companies' robust investment in information equipment, and a halt in semiconductor price declines would lead to the sharp rise in profits in 1997/98.
Some of Fujitsu's major overseas units are likely to start posting profits in 1997/98, the paper added.
A spokesman for Fujitsu was not immediately available to comment on the report.
